message.content: In one of the discussions about the game Red Dead Redemption 2, Fionnuala shared a humorous experience she had. She mentioned, "Once, I had a hilarious glitch too! One time, I was on a mission, and Arthur ended up floating in mid-air after." This indicates that Fionnuala encountered a glitch where Arthur (the main character) somehow floated in the air during a mission, which resulted in a comedic situation. While the exact nature of the glitch isn't detailed, it likely involved Arthur being unable to land due to a game bug or malfunction. Such glitches often occur in open-world games and can lead to amusing moments for players.
